set.title: Narrow the desk check command so it stops running the 5,000-card timing test on every push (desk.config.json, Claude cannot edit it)
set.why: desk wt finish runs 'npm run build && npm test' locally on every push, including planning-only branches, and the timing test is slow and was flaky in parallel. CI already skips planning-only changes; only the local check still runs everything.

options.label: Use the code-only check
options.why: set the repo check to 'npm run build && npx vitest run --exclude "**/startup*"' (Recommended): fast and drops only the timing test, which CI e2e (perf.spec) still covers

options.label: Leave it
options.why: no change, accept the slower local check

set.note: ruled: Use the code-only check
